import networkx as nx
import random
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(14))
G.add_edges_from([(2,11), (1,5), (2,12), (2,4), (0,5), (3,7), (2,13), (3,13)])
while G.number_of_edges() < 16:
    u = random.randint(0, 13)
    v = random.randint(u+1, 13)
    if not G.has_edge(u, v):
        G.add_edge(u, v)
while G.number_of_edges() > 41:
    u = random.choice(list(G.nodes))
    v = random.choice(list(G.nodes))
    if u < v and G.has_edge(u, v):
        G.remove_edge(u, v)
print(list(G.edges))
